scope: Fresh source-level validation of absolute-risk ranking with and without the frozen dual research gate
tie_break: Ascending time then ordered actor IDs

confirmation.rule: Uniform source sample from the A/B candidate-source union before native outcomes; four supported maximum-interaction corners, no substitutions

screening_readiness.meaning: Predeclared engineering checks for candidate screening; no significance guarantee or automatic PPO launch

fixed_budget: One fixed source cohort. Retain every source, abstention, candidate and continuation; no event-conditioned extension or replacement. Different cases from the same source share continuation seeds for A/B pairing; different sources have disjoint seeds.
state_law: Within each selector, uniform selected source episode and its one fixed selected state; report all-source coverage separately
uncertainty: Paired whole-source cluster bootstrap for source generalization; fixed-state stratified Monte Carlo standard errors reported separately
